description: This file defines classes and functions related to window functions in PySpark SQL, including Window and WindowSpec classes, with methods for partitioning, ordering, and range specifications for window operations.

classes.name: Window
classes.description: A class extending ParentWindow providing static methods for creating window specifications based on partitioning, ordering, and range boundaries.

classes.name: WindowSpec
classes.description: A class extending ParentWindowSpec representing a specific window specification with methods for further configuration.

methods.name: _to_java_cols
methods.description: Converts a tuple of column names or Column objects into a JavaObject sequence for Spark.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec partitioned by specified columns.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Creates a WindowSpec ordered by specified columns.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Defines a frame of rows between start and end relative to the current row.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Defines a range frame between start and end values.

methods.name: __new__
methods.description: Creates a new WindowSpec instance wrapping a JavaObject.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a WindowSpec with a JavaObject.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Returns a new WindowSpec with specified partitioning columns.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Returns a new WindowSpec with specified ordering columns.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Returns a new WindowSpec with specified row frame boundaries.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Returns a new WindowSpec with specified range boundaries.
